Iran's Nuclear Ambitions: Israel Vows Action Amidst Unverified IRGC Claims

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that Israel will take all necessary actions to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons. This statement followed reports by Israeli media citing an alleged admission by IRGC Commander Vahidi that Iran will continue to pursue nuclear weapons. The authenticity of Vahidi's alleged statements remains unverified amidst ongoing tensions between the US and Iran over Tehran's nuclear program.
